title: iPhone BloodPressureSheet.swift has no systolic auto-advance (US-02 AC6 parity owed)
evidence: US-02 AC6: after an unambiguous in-range systolic the focus moves to diastolic (at once for 100-250; after a short pause for 60-99). The web's vitals grid cell and, since H71 (PR 1508, Codex R2), the Blood Pressure value page both do this (bpSysAdvance, useAutoAdvance). The iPhone's sheet focuses systolic on appear (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/BloodPressureSheet.swift:63, focus = .systolic) and never moves it: nothing watches the systolic text. US-02 AC6 names the gap. Fix: the same move in Swift with AC6b and AC6c's rules (no move if the focus left during the pause; a digit edited back cancels), with a UI test. (H73)
